notes.title: Hotfix for language support
notes.content: Some texts in some languages with longer texts were not fully visible. Fixed them. Now several languages are live.

notes.title: Language support
notes.content:
Added language support for game. Now this festival game can be played using languages of 
arabic, chinese (simple), finnish, german, portuguese, brazilian, french, spanish, swedish and japanese. Translations are not perfect, but the game is good. If you want, you can come to our discord channel to make translations better for future versions.
